title: Settlement Fee Kept When a Marketplace Orders Replacement Charge Is Refunded
content:
**Rule.** The settlement fee kept by the Marketplace Orders replacement-charge refund is the settlement fee the captured charge carried, since the settlement fee is never refunded: its overdue days run from the unreturned-replacement deadline to the original unit's first carrier scan where that scan stands on or before the capture date, are none where the return was set up as a carrier pickup with no scan by the capture date, and otherwise run to the capture date; at least the long-overdue days of 14 keep the per-day settlement fee of USD 0.50 once for every overdue day; at least the short-overdue days of 7 but fewer than 14 keep one flat short-overdue fee of USD 3.50; fewer overdue days keep no fee.

The settlement fee kept is taken off the captured charge, giving the refundable charge, which is never below zero.

## Overdue days of the captured charge

The capture date is the date of the unreturned-replacement charge capture on the order. The deadline is the date recorded on the replacement entry plus the option's unreturned replacement days.

| Records at the capture date | Overdue days run to |
|---|---|
| a first carrier scan of the original stands on or before the capture date | the first scan date |
| carrier pickup set up, no scan by the capture date | none counted |
| any other case | the capture date |

| Overdue days | Fee kept (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 to 6 | 0.00 |
| 7 to 13 | 3.50 |
| 14 or more | the number of days times 0.50 |

### Hypothetical case

Deadline 3 June; a UPS drop-off with no scan by a capture on 19 June: 16 overdue days, fee kept 16 times 0.50, that is USD 8.00. A captured charge of USD 56.60 then gives a refundable charge of USD 48.60.
